gemini_ui_rescue.note: Shared Test-only helper robie_job_engine.gemini_ui_rescue. Registered selectors stay the primary path. On ROBIE_ENV=TEST, one missing or ambiguous named control, a coded locator that does not resolve to one element, or a Playwright timeout on that wait may ask Gemini once for a single unique locator. view_activity_by is an exception: the existing #606 selector is resolved directly, and zero matches, multiple matches, or a page that is not the Policy Activity form hold without asking Gemini. communications_link is the same kind of exception: a[data-at="policy-activity-tab-communications"], or one link named Communications when that element is absent, is resolved directly on processed-date results. A unique pair that both queries already agree on is clicked; inner text and the label helper are not a second veto. Zero matches, multiple matches, a hidden match, queries that hit different elements, a data-at-only or named-only match with a different name, or a page that is not processed-date results holds with both counts and the safe page URL, without asking Gemini. The same helper is wired for EZLynx, Ascend, this FAO page, and the Playwright write guard (Geico and other portals that run through playwright_exec). Production skips the rescue. Positional .first/.nth answers are refused. This does not file EZLynx documents or notes.

manage_policies.name: manage_policies
manage_policies.description: FAO header parent link. Live accessible name is Manage Policies Home because aria-label wins over the visible text Manage Policies. The click accepts this data-at selector or one link/button whose accessible name matches ^Manage Policies. Hidden until Main Navigation is expanded once. Zero matches or more than one element holds.

main_nav_drawer.name: main_nav_drawer
main_nav_drawer.description: Open FAO Main Nav drawer. The held pull blocked Policy Activity with this class; the panel content was Agency Admin. Before Policy Activity, close it with Escape, one overlay, or one close control, then wait until this class is gone. If it stays, hold and do not click Policy Activity. Do not click Agency Admin. A closed drawer has no match and is left alone.

policy_activity.name: policy_activity
policy_activity.description: Header link Policy Activity, or the Manage Policies landing link View policy activity reports. Either may be hidden until Main Navigation is expanded once. Two visible matches hold.

view_activity_by.name: view_activity_by
view_activity_by.description: Existing #606 Policy Activity control. Registered selector select#PDDateType[name="DateType"] is not a new locator. It must be the one visible select on /managepolicies/policyactivity. The accessible name View Activity By must be this same element, or the element is unlabeled. Exactly one visible match selects option PROCESSEDDATE and the pull continues to the date range, Get Policy Activity, and Communications. Zero matches, more than one match, a hidden match, a different page, or a different accessible name holds before any option is selected. The hold reports select#PDDateType and select[name="DateType"] counts and the safe page URL. Those counts are not click targets. This field does not ask Gemini. Positional .first/.nth is not used.

processed_date_option.name: processed_date_option
processed_date_option.description: Option inside View Activity By, not a page-wide search. Visible text must be Processed Date and the value must be PROCESSEDDATE. A second option with that value or that text holds.

processed_date_range.name: processed_date_range
processed_date_range.description: Preset select on Policy Activity, present with View Activity By. Options include Yesterday, Last 30 Days, and Select Date Range. Choose the single option whose visible text is Select Date Range; its value is read from that option and is not hardcoded. That choice reveals page-level Start Date and End Date. Those inputs are not descendants of this select. A missing select, a second select, a missing or second Select Date Range option, or a missing or shared option value holds.

processed_date_from.name: processed_date_from
processed_date_from.description: Inclusive processed-date start. Page-level HTML date input. It can be in the DOM while hidden until Select Date Range is chosen on select#PDDateRange. The run waits until this one element is visible, fills YYYY-MM-DD, and reads it back. The accessible name Start Date must be this same element. The old label Processed date from is not on this page.

processed_date_to.name: processed_date_to
processed_date_to.description: Inclusive processed-date end. Page-level HTML date input. It can be in the DOM while hidden until Select Date Range is chosen on select#PDDateRange. The run waits until this one element is visible, fills YYYY-MM-DD, and reads it back. The accessible name End Date must be this same element.

get_policy_activity.name: get_policy_activity
get_policy_activity.description: Submits the processed-date window and navigates to processed-date results. Live control value is Get Policy Activity. Unique and visible on the Policy Activity form. It is not inside select#PDDateRange. The next page is processeddateresults, not a Search button.

processed_date_results.name: processed_date_results
processed_date_results.description: Page reached by Get Policy Activity. Live prove on hermes-test-01 release 00a0ae294ec0 landed on https://www.foragentsonly.com/managepolicies/policyactivity/processeddateresults/cancels/ with title Policy Activity Processed Date Results – Cancels, Lapses, Reinstates. Sibling sections are the same prefix with one other slug. The worker matches that URL. It does not click this title and it does not click Search. A missing URL, a query, or an extra path segment holds.

communications_link.name: communications_link
communications_link.description: Section link on processed-date results, including the cancels landing after Get Policy Activity. Registered control a[data-at="policy-activity-tab-communications"] is already on main from #614 and #616. It is not a new selector and it is not role=tab. When that data-at element and one link named Communications are the same visible element, that pair is clicked. Inner text and the label helper are not a second veto: an icon, extra whitespace, or a Communications label on a different element does not hold the pair. One visible data-at match is also clicked when the named link is absent and the element is unlabeled or its visible text and readable name are Communications. One link named Communications is clicked when the data-at element is absent and that same identity check passes. Both queries must be the same element when both match. The run does not require role=tab and does not read aria-selected. After the click the URL must be processeddateresults with section communications or underwriting (optional legacy suffix: underwriting, underwritinglegacy, underwriting-legacy, underwriting_legacy). Zero matches, more than one match, a hidden match, a page that is not processeddateresults, two queries that hit different elements, or a data-at-only or named-only match whose visible text or readable name is not Communications holds before Communications is clicked. The hold reports the data-at count, the link:Communications count, and the page URL with query, fragment, and userinfo removed. Those counts are not click targets. This field does not ask Gemini. Search is not clicked. Positional .first/.nth is not used. Memo and PDF controls are not part of this click.
